definitions.explanation: The bony prominence on each side of the ankle joint. Also refers to the ankle area in general.

examples.japanese: ⟦サッカー→サッカー：04726_sakkaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{踝|くるぶし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ひねった→捻る：00102_hineru⟧。
examples.english: I twisted my ankle playing soccer.

examples.japanese: {踝|くるぶし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦{丈|たけ}→丈：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パンツ→パンツ：01374_pantsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流行|はや}って→流行る：02400_hayaru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Pants that show your ankles are in style.

examples.japanese: {踝|くるぶし}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かった→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I got wet up to my ankles.

notes:
KANJI: Often written in hiragana as くるぶし. The kanji {踝|くるぶし} is less common.

ANATOMY:
- ⟦{内|うち}→内：01328_uchi⟧くるぶし - inner ankle (medial malleolus)
- ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧くるぶし - outer ankle (lateral malleolus)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {踝|くるぶし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ひねる→捻る：00102_hineru⟧ - to twist one's ankle
- {踝|くるぶし}⟦{丈|たけ}→丈：noentry⟧ - ankle-length
- {踝|くるぶし}⟦ソックス→ソックス：29839_sokkusu⟧ - ankle socks

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- ⟦{足首|あしくび}→足首：00918_ashikubi⟧ - ankle (more general term for the ankle area)
- ⟦{踵|かかと}→踵：04265_kakato⟧ - heel
- ⟦{爪先|つまさき}→爪先：16422_tsumasaki⟧ - toes, toe area
